name: sorrycode-image2
description: Call the unified SorryCode Images API to generate or edit images.

interface.shortDescription: Generate and edit images through SorryCode
interface.longDescription: SorryCode Image2 wraps the SorryCode Images API with automatic routing between gpt-image-2-all for standard sizes and gpt-image-2 for 2K/4K output. It checks SORRYCODE_API_KEY, writes request diagnostics, and saves generated images under outputs/images/.
defaultPrompt: Use SorryCode Image2 to generate an image
Use SorryCode Image2 to edit this local image
